## Hypothesis

The trend direction is a critical factor in determining the validity of a trade setup. By incorporating the trend direction into the entry path, we can block trades that are counter to the prevailing trend, thereby improving the overall performance of the engine.

## Mechanism

The proposed candidate introduces a new veto primitive that checks the trend direction using the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function. If the trend direction is not aligned with the trade setup, the trade is blocked.
